noAnchorGaps.concept: Tenkan above Kijun confirming upward momentum (bullish TK cross)
noAnchorGaps.quote: The Tenkan is above the Kijun, confirming upward momentum.
noAnchorGaps.why: move ichimoku exposes only pullback(pt) and aboveCloud(pt); there is no anchor on the Tenkan/Kijun lines or their cross. The Tenkan and Kijun lines are already drawn by the move, so the TK relationship cannot be labelled without inventing an anchor.

noAnchorGaps.concept: Risk/stop defined just below the cloud
noAnchorGaps.quote: that's our trigger to join the trend with risk defined just below the cloud
noAnchorGaps.why: move ichimoku exposes no level (L) anchor — only point anchors pullback and aboveCloud — so a stop level/zone on the lower cloud edge has no valid anchor to attach to.

notes: Both CHART beats use move 'ichimoku'. Beat bias correctly shows note@aboveCloud for the bullish cloud bias; beat entry correctly shows note@pullback (pullback to Kijun = entry) and note@aboveCloud (ride the trend). All existing show items use valid point anchors with the note kind (point-anchor compatible) — no fixes needed. The two locatable references the auditor flagged (TK cross; stop below cloud) genuinely have no exposed anchor on the ichimoku move, so they remain noAnchorGaps — not invented. intro and recap are CONCEPT beats (no chart, skipped).
